critical_code_review_comments: EquipmentTables.jsx implementation is clean, self-contained, uses proper React state, semantic aria-pressed, and data-testid coverage on every interactive/informational element.
Filter logic (lines 104-107) is straightforward and correct.

Minor: HERO_ROWS.indexOf(r) at line 173 works but is O(n) per row; using original index from array is unnecessary since heroRows already carries context — a mapped {row, idx} pair would be cleaner. Non-blocking.
